# Nicklas Andersson: "Helt ofrånkomligt att spara ihop några miljoner"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-20  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is mostly a personal-finance episode with Nicklas Andersson and Albin of Uppesittarkväll. They mark the show's 10th anniversary and argue that saving about 10% of disposable income steadily will add up to a million kronor or more over time. Stocks come up in a short 'best and worst holdings' segment: Storytel is up and Lyko is down. They also point to strong cybersecurity demand as AI spreads, and say luxury stocks are weak because of the Chinese consumer and turmoil in France. H&M gets a critical look against Inditex: its earnings per share have not grown since 2007 and its margins have fallen.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 LYKO-A — Lyko | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

The host is down about 21% this year but says he has not given up and keeps holding.

#### Reasoning

Albin names Lyko as his worst holding this year, down about 21%. He says twice that he has not given up, which suggests he will keep the position despite the drop. The episode gives no fundamental thesis, so conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the share keeps falling and the host's original hopes for the company are not met

> *"Sämst Lykon är 21 så de tar nästan ut varandra. Ja, men Lykon hade du förhoppningar på. Jag har inte gett upp. Jag har inte gett upp."*

---

### 🟡 STORY-B — Storytel | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The host's best holding this year, up about 33%.

#### Reasoning

Albin holds Storytel and names it his best performer this year, up about 33%. He gives no forward-looking thesis, so this is an implied hold based only on his position and performance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the momentum reverses

> *"Av mina innehav, det som har gått bäst i år är Storytel upp 33 ungefär."*

---

### 🟠 HM-B — H&M | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

EPS flat since 2007 and margin down from 23% to about 8%; it lost ground to Inditex but is now adapting.

#### Reasoning

The hosts compare H&M with Inditex. H&M's EPS and profit have not grown since 2007, its margin has fallen from 23% to about 8%, and it was slow to adapt to tougher competition. A store visit left them unimpressed with the clothes. They do acknowledge that H&M is now adapting. The tone is negative, but they give no explicit buy or sell call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin recovery fails to materialise
- if the store overhaul does not lift sales

> *"Men vinsten per aktie för H&ampP har inte ökat sedan 2007. Total vinst har inte heller ökat sedan 2007."*
